title: Conklin Landing RV Park

services.name: RV site
services.desc: Both RV Parks offer a boat launch and dock. Parking is available for your vehicle and trailer when you use the launch. Every RV site in both Parks have water, sewer and 50/30/20 amp electrical hook-ups. The Parks offer both pull-thru and back in sites. Bridgeport Marina RV Park offers Fire Pits with BBQ grills or Pedestal Grills located at some sites and available in the common areas of the park.
